sources.label: Full support and international waiver eligibility

english.toefl: 90 before January 21, 2026; 4.5 on or after January 21, 2026
english.note: IELTS 7 is a recommended minimum. Programs may require higher scores. English-medium degrees may exempt testing; applicants outside the listed countries should arrange a Registrar/Dean letter confirming English instruction.

applicationFee.note: Documented financial hardship: request through the application with an explanation and accepted financial-aid/FAFSA/CSS/unemployment/test-fee-reduction documentation. Recommended at least two weeks before deadline. International applicants should confirm documentation eligibility. Program funding page explicitly allows international need-based waivers, superseding the US-only wording on its checklist. Program-participation requests (e.g. SACNAS/MARC/Leadership Alliance) should reach NSGP at least seven days before the deadline with proof.

documents: College transcripts with certified English translations where needed
Personal statement (maximum two single-spaced pages, PDF)
Program short answers: research failure, teamwork strengths/weaknesses, intellectual contribution
requirements.note: At least two recommendations should be from faculty at the current or most recently attended institution. Recommenders submit online; Interfolio not accepted. Official final transcripts required before matriculation. Separate Brown and NIH applications needed if applying to both Brown Neuroscience and the Brown–NIH partnership. Unofficial transcripts/scores accepted initially; official TOEFL needed for an offer. Language tests valid two years; confirm program undergraduate-study exemption versus central degree-based exemption.

funding.note: Central doctoral support applies to domestic and foreign students, conditional on satisfactory academic progress; transfer-student funding may vary. All Neuroscience/Brown–NIH students fully supported during graduate school; stipend, tuition, health insurance and health-services fee, plus a one-time transition stipend. No financial-support forms needed.

deadlines.note: Current central program listing; older department FAQ dates are not substituted.
